observations.metric: RNA pathway enrichment (HALLMARK, C0001 vs rest)
observations.finding: 26 of 50 tested pathways significant at q<0.05 (min q=0.0003). Top effects: PANCREAS_BETA_CELLS down (SMD -0.978, q=0.000375), HEHE_METABOLISM down (SMD -0.873, q=0.0003), FATTY_ACID_METABOLISM down (SMD -0.803, q=0.00157), ALLOGRAFT_REJECTION up (SMD +0.783, q=0.000375), IL6_JAK_STAT3 up (SMD +0.759, q=0.000375).
20 of 49 features significant at q<0.05 (min q=5.2e-05). VHL, PBRM1, SETD2, BAP1 loci all higher_in_set with Cliffs delta ~0.55-0.58; chr12p higher_in_set (delta 0.532, q=0.000125).

7 of 107 features significant. CDKN2A loss enriched (36.2% vs 8.9%, OR 5.82, 95% CI 1.83-18.52, q=0.0107); chr6p loss and PTEN loss enriched (18.97% vs 0%, OR 22.0, q=0.015); chr12p gain and chr20q gain enriched (24.1% vs 4.4%, OR 6.84, q=0.039).

biological_support.statistical_interpretation: Coherent, strongly significant RNA and CNV signals define C0001. RNA shows a distinct metabolic/immune profile; CNV shows coordinated 3p tumor-suppressor locus differences and recurrent CDKN2A/PTEN losses with gains at 12p/20q. Effect sizes are moderate-to-large with adjusted significance.
biological_support.medical_interpretation: C0001 carries a biologically coherent molecular profile consistent with a ccRCC subtype characterized by 3p locus alterations and CDKN2A/PTEN loss with immune/metabolic pathway shifts. This is descriptive molecular evidence only; no prognostic or clinical inference is made.
limitations: WXS mutation-level evidence was not available in this round; mutation corroboration is absent.
Pathway and CNV findings are relative to the rest of the partition and do not establish subtype identity independently.

observations.finding: Median silhouette per modality: ct -0.0011, wsi 0.0108, rna 0.0238, cnv 0.0076. Patient membership support distribution: 1 modality=5, 2=20, 3=24, 4=9; median support count 3.0; all-estimable-positive fraction 0.155.

Fused binary probe median silhouette 0.000322, fraction positive 0.776; resampling median ARI 0.357, consensus separation 0.335, PAC 0.843. Boundary to C0002: fused pair median silhouette 0.000418, left/right fraction margin positive 0.879/1.0; per-modality pair silhouettes: rna 0.0241, wsi 0.0142, cnv 0.0080, ct -1.3e-05.

cross_modal_consistency.statistical_interpretation: Membership is supported by a median of 3 of 4 modalities, with RNA and WSI contributing the strongest positive silhouettes and CT near zero. Internal fused separation is weak (silhouette ~0.0003) and resampling stability is modest (ARI 0.357, PAC 0.843). Boundary separation from C0002 is small but directionally positive in fused, RNA, WSI, and CNV spaces.
cross_modal_consistency.medical_interpretation: C0001 shows partial cross-modal membership coherence, strongest in RNA and WSI, with weak internal fused structure and a modest boundary against C0002. This describes membership compatibility, not independent validation.
limitations: Resampling was performed on the existing SNF affinity subgraph; modality affinities and SNF were not re-estimated.
Structural characterization describes the current partition and does not independently validate biological subtype identity.

observations.finding: No significant technical association for C0001. All tissue_source_site, ct_phase, ct_manufacturer, ct_scanner_model, ct_reconstruction_kernel, ct_slice_thickness, ct_z_spacing, ct_pixel_spacing comparisons have q=1.0 (CJ level q=0.977). Deterministic flags: categorical_warning_association=false, numeric_significant_association=false, notable_technical_association=false.

confounder_exclusion.statistical_interpretation: No technical factor shows a significant or notable association with C0001 membership. Effect sizes are small (Cramer's V < 0.2; epsilon-squared near 0).
confounder_exclusion.medical_interpretation: Technical acquisition and site factors do not provide a plausible competing explanation for C0001 membership. The candidate is defined by RNA/CNV biology rather than technical artifacts.
limitations: Only the supplied technical fields were assessed; unmeasured batch or processing factors cannot be excluded.

observations.finding: Stage available for 103 patients. Contingency: C0001 I=28, II=5, III=14, IV=11; C0002 I=28, II=4, III=9, IV=4. Adjusted Rand Index -0.0099, homogeneity 0.0124, completeness 0.0210.
Grade available for 103 patients. Contingency: C0001 G2=20, G3=24, G4=14; C0002 G2=19, G3=23, G4=3. Adjusted Rand Index -0.0009, homogeneity 0.0291, completeness 0.0434.

known_label_echo.statistical_interpretation: ARI near zero for both stage and grade indicates essentially no overlap between the partition and these clinical labels. Homogeneity and completeness are very low.
known_label_echo.medical_interpretation: The partition does not echo TCGA stage or grade labels. Low overlap does not by itself establish molecular novelty, and published molecular taxonomies were not evaluated.
limitations: Only TCGA stage and grade labels are assessable in the current data.
Published molecular ccRCC subtype taxonomies were not evaluated.
Low stage or grade overlap does not by itself establish molecular novelty.
